regression_agreement.interpretation: Development/regression agreement only; these values are not independent accuracy, precision, recall, F1 or generalisation estimates.

corrected_failure_families: Cinearchives catalogue roots are treated as index surfaces while sufficiently specific catalogue detail routes can resolve as items.
Blocked Cinearchives AJAX keyword/filter endpoints preserve search_or_index semantics independently from collector_blocked access state.
Cinememoire fonds and thematic archive browsing surfaces are treated as indexes rather than archive landing pages or generic editorial pages.
Strong Cinememoire fiche-film routes are not suppressed by repeated archive path context or generic JSON-LD Article metadata.
Accessible restricted/personal routes such as /acces-pro retain restricted_or_unavailable semantic role while access state remains accessible.
EYE facet/filter query parameters dominate year-like path identifiers so filtered year surfaces remain search_or_index.
Luce detail pages can be confirmed as audiovisual_item when audiovisual frame metadata is present even if the collector extracts no direct media URL.

calibration_smoke.workflow_name: T2A MAR surface typing calibration smoke 2.1

scientific_decision: Accept M3 protocol 2.1.0 only as a calibrated development candidate. Preregister and run a new prediction-frozen independent ecological validation on unseen surfaces before any claim of generalisation or before scaling M4.
limitations: All 50 human-labelled units used for the 50/50 regression agreement are now known development data.
The 33-unit set was independent only for evaluation of protocol 2.0.0; after its labels informed protocol 2.1.0 it cannot validate 2.1.0 independently.
Several protocol classes remain sparsely represented or absent in the known development labels.
The 25-unit calibration smoke was not human-reviewed for a new performance estimate and is not an independent validation sample.
Entity- and platform-specific rules may still overfit known route patterns.
prohibited_interpretations: 50/50 development agreement must not be reported as independent accuracy or performance
does not justify scaling M4 yet
does not modify the official T2 baseline
does not establish institutional AI use or AI participation in audiovisual content
